title: 第四十四章 旧势落幕第四十三章 趁乱窃经
content_zh:
天亮的时候，金陵城安静了一些。
天幕山庄的大门敞开着，院子里一片狼藉。碎纸片散了一地，被风吹起来，在半空中打着转。
有人在山庄门口贴了一张纸条。
上面写着：“天幕山庄就此解散，名下产业由金陵府衙接管。”
没有落款。
不知道是谁贴的。
也没有人去撕。
一个时代就这么结束了。
城东的长乐帮分舵里，上官复坐在后厅，手里捧着一碗热茶。
他面前的桌上放着一本账册，是赵四连夜从天幕山庄书房里抢出来的。上面记着天幕山庄二十年来的收入和支出，还有各地产业的地契编号。
“能用的人有多少。”
他问。
赵四站在他面前，弯着腰。
“回帮主，天幕山庄散了的那些护院和弟子，我们收了二十七个。武艺一般，但熟路。”
“熟路就好。”上官复说，“各地的分舵，需要认得路的人。”
他翻开账册，看了一页，合上了。
“欧阳长青这辈子，攒了不少东西。”
“是啊。光是地契就有……”
“他攒的东西，现在都是我们的了。”上官复打断他，“但他攒了一辈子的仇家，也是我们的了。”
赵四不敢接话。

上官复站起来，走到窗边。
窗外是一条窄巷子。巷子尽头连着大街，街上有人在走，有人在看，有人在低声交谈。
“萧无恨走了没有。”
“还没。还在城南那家客栈。”
“他什么时候走。”
“听说今天就走。往西北方向。”
上官复的手指在窗框上敲了两下。
“往西北……飞鹰堡。”
“帮主好眼力。”
“不是我眼力好。”上官复说，“是这本账册上写着呢。”
他转过身，拿起桌上的账册。
“欧阳长青和骆一禾之间，有盐路上的往来。天幕山庄每年从飞鹰堡进三千斤青盐，在江南卖。这条线，骆一禾占了七成的利。现在欧阳长青死了，骆一禾少了一个大主顾。他一定会找下家。”
“那我们……”
content_en:
At dawn, Jinling City became quieter.
The door of Tianmu Villa was open, and the yard was in a mess. The pieces of paper were scattered on the ground, blown up by the wind, and spinning in the air.
Someone posted a note on the door of the villa.
It read: "Tianmu Villa has been dissolved, and the property under its name has been taken over by the Jinling Government Office."
No signature.
Don't know who posted it.
No one is going to tear it apart.
An era has ended.
In the Changle Gang branch in the east of the city, Shangguan Fu was sitting in the back hall, holding a bowl of hot tea in his hand.
There was an account book on the table in front of him, which Zhao Si snatched out from the study room of Tianmu Villa overnight. It records the income and expenditure of Tianmu Villa over the past twenty years, as well as the title deed numbers of properties in various places.
"How many people can use it."
he asked.
Zhao Si stood in front of him, bending down.
"Back to the gang leader, we have taken in twenty-seven of the guards and disciples who have been separated from Tianmu Villa. Their martial arts skills are average, but they are familiar with the road."
"It's good to be familiar with the road." Shangguan Fu said, "The helmsmen in various places need people who know the road."
He opened the account book, read a page, and closed it.
"Ouyang Changqing has saved a lot of things in his life."
"Yes. Just the title deed alone..."
"The things he saved are now ours." Shangguan Fu interrupted him, "But the enemies he has saved his whole life are also ours."
Zhao Si didn't dare to answer.
Shangguan Fu stood up and walked to the window.
Outside the window is a narrow alley. The end of the alley connects to the street. There are people walking on the street, watching, and talking in low voices.
"Has Xiao Wuhen left?"
"Not yet. Still at the inn in the south of the city."
"When will he leave?"
"I heard we're leaving today. To the northwest."
Shangguan Fu tapped the window frame twice with his fingers.
"To the northwest...Flying Eagle Castle."
"The gang leader has good eyesight."
"It's not that I have good eyesight." Shangguan Fu said, "It's written in this account book."
He turned around and picked up the account book on the table.
"There is a salt road between Ouyang Changqing and Luo Yihe. Every year, Tianmu Villa imports three thousand kilograms of green salt from Feiyingbao and sells it in Jiangnan. Luo Yihe takes 70% of the profits on this line. Now that Ouyang Changqing is dead, Luo Yihe has lost a big customer. He will definitely find another home."
"Then let's..."
